sentences.en: This one, it's arguably still going.
sentences.zh: 而这场战争，可以说是仍在继续。

sentences.en: And that has placed an inordinate demand on the soldiers and the reservists who have been going in and out of battle and combat all this time.
sentences.zh: 这给那些一直进出战区和战斗的士兵和预备役人员提出了过高的要求。

sentences.en: I mean, lots of people have died.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很多人丧生了。

sentences.en: Families have been really tested.
sentences.zh: 家庭受到了真正的考验。

sentences.en: It's difficult to hold down a job when you're going off and serving for 100 days at a time.
sentences.zh: 当你一去服役就是100天时，很难保住一份工作。

sentences.en: And compounding that and really exacerbating the tensions in this society is the fact that a lot of Israelis just don't serve.
sentences.zh: 雪上加霜的是，更真正加剧这个社会紧张局势的是这样一个事实：许多以色列人根本不服役。

sentences.en: Ultra-Orthodox, who are growing as a percentage of the population rapidly, they have large families
sentences.zh: 超正统犹太人占人口的比例增长迅速，他们家庭规模大

sentences.en: and they start having families young, they have an exemption for years from serving, but that was formally overturned in 2024.
sentences.zh: 且成家早，他们多年来一直享有服役豁免权，但这在2024年被正式推翻了。

sentences.en: So it's no longer legal, but really they are resisting serving.
sentences.zh: 所以这不再合法了，但实际上他们一直在抵制服役。

sentences.en: They're now being openly called draft dodgers, and some are starting to be arrested for it, but their leaders are defiant.
sentences.zh: 他们现在公开被称为逃兵，有些人开始因此被捕，但他们的领导人态度强硬。

sentences.en: They're refusing to do this.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝这样做。

sentences.en: And their political parties are an essential part of the current Netanyahu-led government.
sentences.zh: 而他们的政党是当前由内塔尼亚胡领导的政府的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: He relies on them for support.
sentences.zh: 他依靠他们的支持。

sentences.en: They rely on him for protection from, among other things, the draft, as well as for really huge subsidies for those growing families.
sentences.zh: 他们依靠他来获得保护，免受诸如兵役等之类的事情的影响，并为那些不断壮大的家庭获得巨额补贴。

sentences.en: And so you have the half of the country, more or less, who serves and holds jobs and pays taxes, protecting and subsidizing people who do none of those things.
sentences.zh: 因此，你有了大约一半的国家，他们服役、有工作、纳税，在保护和补贴那些什么都不做的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This issue of whether the ultra-Orthodox serve in the military, that has been a long-standing issue for years now.
sentences.zh: 关于超正统派是否应该服兵役这个问题，多年来一直是个长期存在的议题。

sentences.en: You said, David, that this exemption is illegal.
sentences.zh: 戴维，你曾说过这项豁免是非法的。

sentences.en: What has Netanyahu said about this more recently, though, as this has become increasingly urgent?
sentences.zh: 不过，鉴于这个问题变得日益紧迫，内塔尼亚胡最近对此有什么说法吗？

sentences.en: So it was interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以这很有意思。

sentences.en: Just the other day, the military arrested a bunch of ultra-Orthodox men for draft division.
sentences.zh: 就在前几天，军方因逃避兵役逮捕了一群超正统派男子。

sentences.en: And Netanyahu came out against these arrests.
sentences.zh: 而内塔尼亚胡却公开反对这些逮捕行动。

sentences.en: He called it an attempt to harm the process of drafting the ultra-Orthodox without coercion.
sentences.zh: 他称这是在没有强迫的情况下破坏超正统派征兵进程的企图。

sentences.en: And basically, he's saying, we're going to get to this.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他的意思是，我们以后会处理这件事的。

sentences.en: You know, our coalition was on the verge of passing a real meaningful draft law.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们的执政联盟当时正濒临通过一项真正有意义的征兵法案。

sentences.en: Re-elect us and we'll do that.
sentences.zh: 再次选我们，我们就会做到这一点。

sentences.en: But the criticism here is that it's just going to keep going because Netanyahu needs the ultra-Orthodox to preserve his hold on power.
sentences.zh: 但这里的批评声音在于，这种情况会一直持续下去，因为内塔尼亚胡需要超正统派来维持他对权力的掌控。

sentences.en: And it's just not important enough to him to risk that for the sake of getting ultra-Orthodox men into the military.
sentences.zh: 为了让超正统派男子参军而去冒这个险，对他来说显然还不够重要。

sentences.en: This is the story of Netanyahu that I think a lot of people are familiar with, this idea that he is willing to put up with a lot in order to keep his coalition together and stay
sentences.zh: 这就是许多人所熟悉的内塔尼亚胡的故事，这种观点认为，为了维持执政联盟并继续掌权，他甘愿忍受很多事情

sentences.en: in power.
sentences.zh: 留在权力宝座上。

sentences.en: You have just described the ultra-Orthodox, but there's a whole other contingent, this right-wing
sentences.zh: 你刚刚描述了超正统派，但还有另一派势力，即由本-格维尔和斯莫特里奇代表的右翼

sentences.en: contingent represented by Ben-Gavir and Smotrich, that gets a lot of the blame, I think, or
sentences.zh: 派系，我认为他们承担了很大一部分指责，或者

sentences.en: responsibility for creating an environment that has enabled an increase in settler violence toward Palestinians in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 说他们创造了一种助长约旦河西岸定居者对巴勒斯坦人暴力行为升级的环境，对此负有责任。

sentences.en: And I think that that, on top of the casualty numbers in Gaza that we have been hearing about
sentences.zh: 我认为，再加上自10月7日以来

sentences.en: since October 7th, all of this feels like it has led Israel to becoming increasingly isolated on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 我们一直听到的加沙伤亡人数，所有这一切让以色列在世界舞台上日益孤立。

sentences.en: That is the image, I think, that a lot of people have.
sentences.zh: 这就是许多人脑海中的印象，我想。

sentences.en: And I wonder, what, if anything, has Netanyahu said about this?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，内塔尼亚胡对此有什么说法吗？哪怕只是一点点。

sentences.en: So, first of all, he explains it in a way, you know, attributing it to anti-Semitism in many cases.
sentences.zh: 首先，他的一种解释方式是，在许多情况下将其归咎于反犹太主义。

sentences.en: He talks about the Muslim immigration in Europe.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了欧洲的穆斯林移民问题。

sentences.en: He talks about Qatari money in the United States funding anti-Israel and anti-Semitic professors, basically.
sentences.zh: 他谈到卡塔尔资金在美国资助反以色列和反犹太主义的教授。

sentences.en: You know, it's very conspiratorial, and it has everything to do with anything except Israel's policies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这非常具有阴谋论色彩，而且除了以色列的政策之外，什么都能扯上关系。

sentences.en: And Israel has always seen itself as kind of a country on the defensive and a defensive crouch.
sentences.zh: 以色列一直把自己视为一个处于防守状态、采取防御姿态的国家。

sentences.en: And now he's talking about Israel as a Sparta, as a kind of nation that's going to have to produce its own weapons if other countries place embargoes on arms dealing to Israel.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他将以色列比作斯巴达，如果其他国家对以色列实施武器禁运，这是一个必须自己生产武器的国家。

sentences.en: Like, it's going to have to live on its own, you know, live off the land kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 就像是，它必须靠自己生存，你知道，有点靠山吃山的那种感觉。

sentences.en: But I think there's, to some degree, Netanyahu's followers, his supporters, already think that the world hates Israel and the world's always going to hate Israel.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，在某种程度上，内塔尼亚胡的追随者和支持者已经认为世界讨厌以色列，并且世界永远会讨厌以色列。

sentences.en: And so, like, they're happy to be sort of given the permission to think that way.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们很高兴能获得以这种方式思考的许可。

sentences.en: Well, also, though, I mean, it strikes me that it's easier for Netanyahu to double down on this
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，我的意思是，让我感到印象深刻的是，当内塔尼亚胡拥有来自美国如此巨额的支持时，他更容易在这种立场上

sentences.en: kind of a stance when he does have such huge amounts of support from the United States.
sentences.zh: 加倍下注。

sentences.en: Hugely powerful ally, which is still supplying Israel with tons of military aid that has allowed it to continue its campaign in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其强大的盟友，它仍在向以色列提供大量军事援助，这使得以色列能够在加沙继续其军事行动。

sentences.en: And of course, the United States joined Israel in its attack on Iran.
sentences.zh: 当然，美国还加入了以色列对伊朗的打击。

sentences.en: So, no, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，完全正确。

sentences.en: And I think Netanyahu's actions and what he says all indicate that he has put all his eggs in the United States basket, and particularly in the Trump administration's basket.
sentences.zh: 我认为内塔尼亚胡的行动和言论都表明，他把所有的赌注都押在了美国的篮子里，尤其是特朗普政府的篮子里。

sentences.en: What his critics and opponents will say is that Donald Trump is not going to be president forever, and what comes thereafter may be the deluge.
sentences.zh: 他的批评者和反对者会说，唐纳德·特朗普不会永远当总统，而随之而来的可能会是一场灾难。

sentences.en: David, you just explained where Netanyahu stands on a bunch of these different issues that have made a lot of people angry at him.
sentences.zh: 戴维，你刚刚解释了内塔尼亚胡在许多不同问题上的立场，正是这些问题让许多人对深感不满。

sentences.en: Whether it's not taking responsibility for October 7th, or not resolving the issue of the ultra-Orthodox draft, or moves that have basically made Israel more of a pariah state.
sentences.zh: 无论是没有为10月7日承担责任，还是没有解决超正统派征兵问题，又或是那些基本上让以色列沦为国际弃儿国的举动。

sentences.en: And yet, he is still neck and neck in the polls, which I think highlights just how deeply divided the country is, as you said, in this moment.
sentences.zh: 然而，他在民调中仍然势均力敌，正如你所说，这凸显了这个国家在此时此刻分裂得有多么严重。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And nothing better encapsulates that division than the fact that the number one candidate to replace him, and the leading party in the opposition camp, is a guy who could not be
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这个事实更能概括这种分歧了：取代他的头号候选人、反对派阵营的领军人物，是一个再也

sentences.en: more unlike Benjamin Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 找不到比本雅明·内塔尼亚胡更不相同的人了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night, you took
sentences.zh: 甚至早在我在夜店当DJ、处于黑胶唱片时代的那些日子里，你每天晚上都要带着

sentences.en: 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史文物的生动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自奥彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies, I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连连看”游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影，喜欢我的狗，还喜欢捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天都创作“拼字蜜蜂”和“字母箱”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com slash games今天就开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: So David, on the other side of the race, the leading opposition candidate is Gadi Eisenkot.
sentences.zh: 那么戴维，在竞选的另一边，反对派领头候选人是加迪·埃森科特。

sentences.en: So tell us what his pitch is and what his appeal is to the broader Israeli public.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我们他的竞选主张是什么，以及他对广大以色列公众的吸引力在哪里。

sentences.en: So Eisenkot is basically offering to heal a sorely divided country.
sentences.zh: 因此，埃森科特基本上提出要治愈一个饱受分裂的国家。

sentences.en: Netanyahu has been stoking divisions, pitting one swath of the public against another, and
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡一直在煽动分歧，让公众的一个群体与另一个群体对立，而

sentences.en: Eisenkot is talking about trying to pull things back together.
sentences.zh: 埃森科特则在谈论试图把大家重新凝聚在一起。

sentences.en: Bam, Eisenkot.
sentences.zh: 哇，埃森科特。

sentences.en: But also, to talk about his appeal, this is a guy who has been around for a long, long time, including as the chief of staff of the Israeli military for four years very recently.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，谈到他的吸引力，这是一个在政坛混迹了非常非常久的人，其中包括在不久前担任了四年以色列军方参谋长。

sentences.en: He was very well-liked.
sentences.zh: 他非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: He had a very kind of, I would say, firm but kindly public persona.
sentences.zh: 我想说，他有着一种非常坚定但又亲切的公众形象。

sentences.en: And he has really made the transition to a politician very, very quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且他非常非常快地完成了向政治家的转型。

sentences.en: When he formed his party a year ago, he was tiny in the polls.
sentences.zh: 一年前他组建政党时，民调支持率还微乎其微。

sentences.en: So that's quite a meteoric rise.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当惊人的崛起。

sentences.en: Can you tell us a little bit about his backstory, David?
sentences.zh: 戴维，你能给我们讲讲他的背景吗？

sentences.en: Like, where is he from and sort of how did he get to this point?
sentences.zh: 比如，他是哪里人，以及他是如何走到这一步的？

sentences.en: It's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And again, it couldn't be more different from the guy he's trying to defeat.
sentences.zh: 而且同样地，这与他试图击败的那个人截然不同。

sentences.en: So Eisenkot was born in the north, in the city of Tiberias, to Moroccan immigrant parents.
sentences.zh: 所以埃森科特出生在北方的城市太巴列，父母是摩洛哥移民。

sentences.en: That makes him a Mizrahi Jew, Jews from the Middle East and North Africa.
sentences.zh: 这使他成为了一名米兹拉希犹太人，即来自中东和北非的犹太人。

sentences.en: I should say that Mizrahi Jews are roughly half the Jews of Israel.
sentences.zh: 我应该说，米兹拉希犹太人大约占以色列犹太人的一半。

sentences.en: And no Mizrahi Jew has ever been prime minister.
sentences.zh: 而且没有哪个米兹拉希犹太人当过总理。

sentences.en: So this is not just who he is.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅关乎他是谁。

sentences.en: It's kind of an important political advantage.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种相当重要的政治优势。

sentences.en: And he grew up and went to high school in Eilat, in the very south of Israel.
sentences.zh: 他在以色列最南端的埃拉特长大并读高中。

sentences.en: That's a really working class town.
sentences.zh: 那是一个真正的工人阶级城镇。

sentences.en: Most Israelis get drafted and serve.
sentences.zh: 大多数以色列人都会被征召并服兵役。

sentences.en: He did when he got out of high school at 18 and went into a brigade called Golani.
sentences.zh: 他18岁高中毕业后就应征入伍，进入了一个名为戈兰尼的旅。

sentences.en: This is a very gritty infantry unit.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常坚韧的步兵部队。

sentences.en: It's not the paratroopers or the commandos.
sentences.zh: 它不是伞兵或突击队。

sentences.en: These are the grunt workers, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这些都是干苦力的基层人员。

sentences.en: They're the grunts.
sentences.zh: 他们就是底层士兵。

sentences.en: And it's also kind of a point of pride that it's really a cross-section.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种骄傲，因为它的成员真正代表了各阶层的缩影。

sentences.en: And he had a very rapid rise.
sentences.zh: 他的晋升非常迅速。

sentences.en: He became the commander of the Golani brigade.
sentences.zh: 他成为了戈兰尼旅的指挥官。

sentences.en: And a number of years later, when there's a shakeup in the military, they need to name a new chief of staff.
sentences.zh: 多年后，当军方发生人事变动时，他们需要任命一位新的参谋长。

sentences.en: And Ehud Barak, then the defense secretary under Netanyahu, recommends that Eisencott be named chief of staff,
sentences.zh: 时任内塔尼亚胡手下国防部长埃胡德·巴拉克推荐埃森科特担任参谋长，

sentences.en: which would leapfrog him over somebody else who was kind of next in line.
sentences.zh: 这将使他越过原本排在顺位前列的其他人。

sentences.en: Amazingly, he turned down the job.
sentences.zh: 令人惊奇的是，他拒绝了这个职位。

sentences.en: He felt that the deputy, the guy who was next in line, it was Benny Gantz, it should go to him.
sentences.zh: 他觉得副手、也就是本来按顺位应该上任的那个人是本尼·甘茨，这个职位应该归他。

sentences.en: Wow, that feels like kind of an unusual move for a politician.
sentences.zh: 哇，这对于一个政治家来说似乎是个很不寻常的举动。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But then in 2015, he's offered the top job again, and this time he says yes.
sentences.zh: 但到了2015年，当人们再次邀请他担任最高职务时，这一次他答应了。

sentences.en: Fast forward to October 7th, 2023, and it's this experienced military man who comes into the government of Netanyahu
sentences.zh: 快进到2023年10月7日，正是这位经验丰富的军人加入了内塔尼亚胡政府

sentences.en: to really buck up a government that is dealing with something Israel has never faced.
sentences.zh: 来大力提振一个正在应对以色列从未面临过局面的政府。

sentences.en: Then, December of 2023, Eisencott's own son, his youngest of five children, a 25-year-old reservist, is killed in a tunnel explosion.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2023年12月，埃森科特自己的儿子，他五个孩子中最小的一个、25岁的预备役军人在地道爆炸中丧生。

sentences.en: And everybody saw that funeral.
sentences.zh: 所有人都看到了那场葬礼。

sentences.en: Like, thousands came to it, including Netanyahu, because of who Eisencott was.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人参加了葬礼，其中包括内塔尼亚胡，因为埃森科特的身份特殊。

sentences.en: Many more watched on television live.
sentences.zh: 更多的人通过电视直播观看了葬礼。

sentences.en: Eisencott gives this heart-rending, very personal eulogy for his son.
sentences.zh: 埃森科特为他的儿子发表了一篇撕心裂肺、非常感人的悼词。

sentences.en: And now he's like the picture of bereavement, in addition to being who he is in the government.
sentences.zh: 现在，除了他在政府中的身份之外，他简直成了丧亲之痛的化身。

sentences.en: It was also an image, I would imagine, that many Israelis could relate to, because many Israelis have also lost somebody in the Gaza war.
sentences.zh: 我想象这也是许多以色列人能够感同身受的画面，因为许多以色列人在加沙战争中也失去了亲人。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So many people have lost someone or had somebody injured.
sentences.zh: 有太多人失去了亲人或有亲人受伤。

sentences.en: You know, you can't avoid knowing people in this country who have experienced a lot of loss.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这个国家里，你不可能不认识经历过巨大丧亲之痛的人。

sentences.en: And the day of the funeral, Eisencott's nephew is killed in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 就在葬礼当天，埃森科特的侄子在加沙阵亡。

sentences.en: He loses another nephew almost a year later.
sentences.zh: 几乎一年后他又失去了另一个侄子。

sentences.en: So now, add that emotional factor to what Eisencott is experiencing as he participates in this government.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，把这种情感因素加到埃森科特参与这届政府时的亲身经历中。

sentences.en: Now, it seems to have gone fairly well at first, but it didn't go well for very long.
sentences.zh: 起初事情似乎进展得相当顺利，但好景不长。

sentences.en: Both Netanyahu and Eisencott are basically trash-talking one another about, you know, what went on behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡和埃森科特基本上都在互相恶语相向，互相指责幕后发生的事情。

sentences.en: Eisencott describes the prime minister as shaking like a leaf in that period, and that he had to kind of really, you know, almost like take the wheel.
sentences.zh: 埃森科特形容这位总理在那段时期里“像风中落叶一样颤抖”，而他自己则不得不真正地、几乎像是“接管方向盘”一样。

sentences.en: But really, what causes Netanyahu and Eisencott to clash is what to do about the hostages.
sentences.zh: 但真正导致内塔尼亚胡和埃森科特发生冲突的是如何处理人质问题。

sentences.en: Netanyahu is under pressure from Smotrich and Bengvir to really just full steam ahead, keep destroying Gaza, keep killing Hamas, eliminating them.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡面临来自斯莫特里奇和本-格维尔的压力，要求全力推进，继续摧毁加沙，继续消灭哈马斯。

sentences.en: But Israelis are crying out to do a deal to get the hostages out.
sentences.zh: 但以色列人强烈要求达成协议以解救人质。

sentences.en: In January of 2024, he goes public with his frustrations.
sentences.zh: 2024年1月，他公开表达了自己的挫败感。

sentences.en: By June, he's out.
sentences.zh: 到了6月，他出局了。

sentences.en: He quits.
sentences.zh: 他辞职了。

sentences.en: He quits the government.
sentences.zh: 他退出了政府。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, a year later, he forms a political party of his own.
sentences.zh: 而且，一年后，他组建了自己的政党。

sentences.en: So Eisencott quits the Netanyahu government in disgust, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来埃森科特是带着厌恶之情退出内塔尼亚胡政府的。

sentences.en: He forms this new party.
sentences.zh: 他组建了这个新党派。

sentences.en: What does he say about what his platform is and what he stands for?
sentences.zh: 关于他的政治纲领和立场，他是怎么说的？

sentences.en: The biggest thing of all, I think, is accountability and responsibility.
sentences.zh: 我认为最重要的一点就是问责制与责任感。

sentences.en: That's both something that Israelis crave, and it's an implicit rebuke and criticism of Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 这既是以色列人所渴望的，也是对内塔尼亚胡的一种含蓄斥责和批评。

sentences.en: As we said, Netanyahu is avoiding the national commission that could deliver accountability wherever it may lead.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，内塔尼亚胡正在逃避那个无论指向何方都能追究责任的国家调查委员会。

sentences.en: So he's promising responsible leadership, and he's calling Bibi an anti-leader.
sentences.zh: 因此，他承诺提供负责任的领导，并称比比为“反领导者”。

sentences.en: You know, he's saying that the way I was trained, when there's credit, you share it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他说，按照我受到的训练，有功劳时，大家分享。

sentences.en: When there's failure, you step forward and own it.
sentences.zh: 有失败时，你要站出来承担责任。

sentences.en: And he's talking about sharing the burden of service and spreading it around and making sure that the ultra-Orthodox do their fair share of military service.
sentences.zh: 他谈到要分担服役负担，将其推广开来，并确保超正统派尽到他们应尽的兵役义务。

sentences.en: Which would seem like a pretty powerful message coming from somebody who lost a son and two nephews in this war.
sentences.zh: 对于一个在这场战争中失去了一个儿子和两个侄子的人来说，这似乎是一个非常有力量的信息。

sentences.en: Very much so.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And that's also a contrast that he has begun drawing himself.
sentences.zh: 这也是他开始刻意制造的一种对比。

sentences.en: In one interview, he talked about how Netanyahu's two sons did really minor or insignificant service when they served in the military.
sentences.zh: 在一次采访中，他谈到内塔尼亚胡的两个儿子在军队服役时，做的事其实非常微不足道或无足轻重。

sentences.en: And one of his sons, who's basically known as a right-wing troll in support of his father on social media,
sentences.zh: 而他的其中一个儿子，基本上以在社交媒体上支持父亲的右翼网络水军而闻名，

sentences.en: spent much of the last three years kind of hanging out in Miami with security to some degree on the taxpayer's dime.
sentences.zh: 在过去三年的大部分时间里，都在迈阿密闲晃，在某种程度上还带着由纳税人出资的安保人员。

sentences.en: So for Eisenkot, it's not beneath him to make that contrast as well.
sentences.zh: 所以对埃森科特来说，进行这种对比也并不跌份。

sentences.en: It's really interesting because it sounds like Eisenkot is very much focused on sharing the responsibility for the war.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为听起来埃森科特非常专注于分担战争的责任。

sentences.en: But he's not really talking a lot, from your description, of the war itself in terms of how it has isolated Israel on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 但根据你的描述，对于战争本身如何使以色列在世界舞台上陷入孤立，他似乎并没有多谈。

sentences.en: So I just sort of wonder what we know about how much he cares about that and what he has said about that, if anything.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，我们所了解到的他对这一点的关心程度如何，以及他对此说了什么（如果有的话）。

sentences.en: Let me just deal with Gaza really quickly because he doesn't talk about Gaza much.
sentences.zh: 让我简要谈谈加沙问题，因为他其实并不怎么谈论加沙。

sentences.en: On Gaza,
sentences.zh: 关于加沙，

sentences.en: he basically says that he wants to work with the Trump administration on its plan to bring a solution in Gaza to get to reconstruction and so on to really end the war to have a settlement that gets Hamas out of government there.
sentences.zh: 他基本上表示，他希望与特朗普政府合作，推行其旨在解决加沙问题、实现重建、真正结束战争、并达成让哈马斯退出当地政府的协议的计划。

sentences.en: This is not a guy whose heart is bleeding for all the Palestinians killed in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这可不是一个为在加沙被杀害的巴勒斯坦人而心碎的人。

sentences.en: This is a guy who wants to finish a job against Hamas one way or the other, whether it's politically or if need be, militarily.
sentences.zh: 这是一个无论通过政治手段还是在必要时通过军事手段，都要彻底完成消灭哈马斯任务的人。

sentences.en: And in the West Bank, he's much more valuable.
sentences.zh: 而在约旦河西岸，他的价值要大得多。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: he basically treats what's going on in the West Bank with extremist violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians as Israel in a hole of its own making and just continuing to dig.
sentences.zh: 他基本上把约旦河西岸正在发生的、犹太定居者对巴勒斯坦人的极端主义暴力行为，视作以色列自己挖的一个越陷越深的坑，并且还在继续往下挖。

sentences.en: And he says the first thing you got to do is stop digging.
sentences.zh: 他说，你首先要做的就是别再往下挖了。

sentences.en: So what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那这意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: So the first thing, he would reestablish the security regime that used to basically prevent this kind of thing, or at least prevent it a lot more than it does now.
sentences.zh: 所以首先，他会重建过去基本上能防止这种事情发生的安全机制，或者至少能比现在更有效地防止这种事情发生。

sentences.en: That means taking the military in the West Bank and its civil administration for the West Bank out from under the control of Smotrich.
sentences.zh: 这意味着将约旦河西岸的军队及其民政管理机构脱离斯莫特里的控制。

sentences.en: And it means taking the Israeli police who have to come in and arrest those settlers out from under the control of Itamar Benvir.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着将不得不介入并逮捕这些定居者的以色列警察脱离伊塔马尔·本-格维尔的控制。

sentences.en: He would go a lot farther, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，他会走得更远。

sentences.en: He's talked about, you know, the first thing he would do in the West Bank is to uproot and evacuate the settlements,
sentences.zh: 他谈到过，你知道，他在约旦河西岸要做的第一件事就是根除和撤离定居点，

sentences.en: the illegal Israeli settlements that have been set up in areas that are really supposed to be reserved for the Palestinians under the old Oslo Accords.
sentences.zh: 那些根据旧的《奥斯陆协议》本应留给巴勒斯坦人的地区所建立的非法以色列定居点。

sentences.en: So he's not talking about Palestinian sovereignty, which Netanyahu might want voters to believe he is or interested in.
sentences.zh: 所以他谈的不是巴勒斯坦主权，内塔尼亚胡可能希望选民相信他想要或对此感兴趣的主权。

sentences.en: He's just talking about restoring a certain stability that Israelis were used to just a few years ago before the attacks on October 7th and before the war.
sentences.zh: 他只是在谈论恢复以色列人在几年前10月7日袭击和战争爆发前所习惯的某种稳定性。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He says that if there will be a final status, you know, permanent solution to the conflict, it is a long way off beyond the horizon and the curvature of the earth.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果要有最终地位，你知道，冲突的永久解决方案，那将是遥遥无期、远在天边的事情。

sentences.en: But he does think that it's better to give the Palestinians reason for hope than to tell them there is no hope.
sentences.zh: 但他确实认为，给巴勒斯坦人希望的理由，总比告诉他们毫无希望要好。

sentences.en: You said, David, that the race is neck and neck, but obviously Israeli elections work differently than they do here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你刚才说选情难分高下，但显然以色列的选举运作方式与我们美国不同。

sentences.en: Can you just walk us through a little bit about what is likely to happen next?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们简单介绍一下接下来可能会发生什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, this is incredibly difficult to understand if you come from a two-party system.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你来自两党制国家，这简直难以理解。

sentences.en: But basically, it's coalition politics.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，这就是联合政治。

sentences.en: You don't vote for a prime minister like you do for a president in the United States.
sentences.zh: 你不像在美国那样为总理投票，就像选总统那样。

sentences.en: You vote for a party.
sentences.zh: 你是为政党投票。

sentences.en: You go into the ballot box and you choose a slip of paper that has the symbol and name of the party that you prefer.
sentences.zh: 你走进投票站，选择一张印有你偏好的政党标志和名称的纸条。

sentences.en: And then, you know, the parties with the most votes get the most seats in the parliament.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，获得最多票数的政党在议会中获得最多的席位。

sentences.en: And the party that has the most seats gets offered the chance to form a government by the president.
sentences.zh: 获得最多席位的政党将获得由总统邀请组建政府的机会。

sentences.en: Now, the polls are all over the place.
sentences.zh: 现在，民调结果乱成一团。

sentences.en: We say that Eisenkot and Netanyahu are neck and neck because Eisenkot is a little bit ahead of Netanyahu in the polls.
sentences.zh: 我们说艾森科特和内塔尼亚胡难分高下，是因为在民调中艾森科特稍微领先内塔尼亚胡一点。

sentences.en: The same goes for their coalitions.
sentences.zh: 他们的政治联盟也是如此。

sentences.en: There could be a clear outcome to this election, but it is perhaps even more likely that given how tight things are, we could have an inconclusive election.
sentences.zh: 这次选举可能会有一个明确的结果，但考虑到选情如此胶着，我们甚至更有可能会迎来一个难分胜负的选举结果。

sentences.en: And that could lead to another election, the way we had several of them in 2019, 2020, 2021.
sentences.zh: 那可能会导致又一次选举，就像我们在2019、2020、2021年经历过的那几次一样。

sentences.en: Or it also could lead to something we haven't seen before.
sentences.zh: 或者也可能导致我们从未见过的情况。

sentences.en: One thing that Eisenkot and his allies are talking about doing is if they do come out ahead, they could start to pass some laws even if they can't form a government.
sentences.zh: 艾森科特及其盟友正在谈论的一件事是，如果他们最终胜出，即使他们无法组建政府，他们也可以开始通过一些法律。

sentences.en: So imagine a new parliament with a new speaker passing laws like maybe one that bans a candidate from running for prime minister if he's facing criminal trial.
sentences.zh: 所以想象一下，一个拥有新议长的全新议会通过一些法律，比如禁止面临刑事审判的候选人竞选总理。

sentences.en: Which would include Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 其中就包括内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Or that imposes term limits on somebody who's served for 19 out of the last 30 years.
sentences.zh: 或者对过去30年中任职19年的人设定任期限制。

sentences.en: Also Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 这也是指内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There's a lot of things they could do if they wanted to and really play political hardball in a way that nobody has in this country before.
sentences.zh: 如果有必要的话，他们可以做很多事情，并以前所未有的方式真正大打政治强硬牌。

sentences.en: But the message I'm getting from you, David, is that this is likely to be quite messy.
sentences.zh: 但我从你这里得到的信息是，大卫，这可能会相当混乱。

sentences.en: We don't know what's going to happen yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And the outcome does not necessarily mean that there will be a clear prime minister in the immediate future.
sentences.zh: 而且这个结果并不一定意味着在不久的将来会出现一个明确的总理。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you think it's confusing now, just wait until next Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得现在就很混乱，那就等着看下周三吧。

sentences.en: Terrific.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, we might end up calling you back on the show, David.
sentences.zh: 好吧，大卫，我们可能最后还得请你回节目做客。

sentences.en: Besides the fact that it's very messy and confusing to a lot of people, as we mentioned, we know that this election feels very existential to people.
sentences.zh: 除了正如我们所提到的，这对许多人来说非常混乱和令人费解之外，我们知道这次选举让人们感到生死攸关。

sentences.en: And I just want to end our conversation by talking about something that's going to feel sort of familiar to folks in the United States,
sentences.zh: 我只想以探讨一件事来结束我们的对话，这件事对美国人来说会有一种似曾相识的感觉，

sentences.en: which is also a deeply divided country where major events have served as sort of Rorschach tests, which is how it sort of sounds like in Israel,
sentences.zh: 这也是一个深度分裂的国家，重大事件曾被用作罗夏墨迹测验般的测试，听起来在以色列也是如此，

sentences.en: where people see Netanyahu as a success or failure.
sentences.zh: 人们把内塔尼亚胡视为成功者或失败者。

sentences.en: And the things that he's done since October 7th, depending on kind of the perspective they were coming from to begin with.
sentences.zh: 以及他在10月7日之后所做的事情，这取决于他们最初的视角。

sentences.en: And I just sort of wonder where you think an election like this that is so existential leaves voters when the results are in, if the results are not the ones that they wanted.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，你认为这样一场如此攸关生死的选举，在结果揭晓后，如果结果并非他们所愿，会将选民置于何地？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People here, certainly those who are unhappy with this current government, there's a lot of talk about despair, about the idea that the country's headed over a cliff.
sentences.zh: 这里的民众，当然是那些对现政府不满的人，有很多关于绝望的讨论，关于这个国家正在走向悬崖边缘的想法。

sentences.en: A lot of people have left Israel.
sentences.zh: 很多人已经离开了以色列。

sentences.en: There's a huge trend to get a second passport for another country.
sentences.zh: 获取另一个国家的第二本护照成了一股巨大的潮流。

sentences.en: The net migration, which has always been into Israel, it's been growing with immigration of Jews from around the world.
sentences.zh: 净移民人数过去一直是流入以色列的，随着世界各地犹太人的移居，这一数字一直在增长。

sentences.en: The last couple of years, more Jews have left than have arrived.
sentences.zh: 但在过去的几年里，离开的犹太人比到达的多。

sentences.en: And it's really striking.
sentences.zh: 这真的很惊人。

sentences.en: Some people say they want to stay and fight.
sentences.zh: 有些人说他们想留下来抗争。

sentences.en: Others are really talking about getting on a plane and never looking back.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则真的在谈论登上飞机，再也不回头。

sentences.en: And I think there's a lot of fear about what could happen, given that things are so divided and so heatedly divided, even if there is a new government.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们对可能发生的事情充满了恐惧，鉴于局势如此分裂，甚至可以说是激烈分裂，即使真的有了新政府。

sentences.en: Could that government really heal?
sentences.zh: 那个政府真的能治愈创伤吗？

sentences.en: Will Netanyahu and his allies go quietly from power?
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡及其盟友会悄然交出权力吗？

sentences.en: There's been political violence in this country before.
sentences.zh: 这个国家以前发生过政治暴力。

sentences.en: Will it whip up?
sentences.zh: 它还会卷土重来吗？

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: It could be entering a dark time.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会进入一段黑暗时期。

sentences.en: Now, having said that, on the other side of the aisle, within Netanyahu's supporters, there's a feeling of triumphalism, the chance to really, this is a right-wing country,
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，在光谱的另一端，在内塔尼亚胡的支持者内部，有一种胜利主义的情绪，这是一个真正的右翼国家，

sentences.en: and this is the chance to cement and to really complete the takeover of the institutions of power that were for so long still held by, you know, holdouts from the left or from,
sentences.zh: 这也是一个巩固并真正完成对权力机构接管的机会，这些权力机构长期以来一直由来自左翼的顽固分子，或者来自，

sentences.en: you know, the liberal world or from the old Ashkenazi elite.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，自由主义世界或老阿什肯纳兹精英阶层所把持。

sentences.en: It's really interesting because Israel is such a small country.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为以色列是一个如此小的国家。

sentences.en: I mean, that does actually feel existential.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这确实让人感觉关乎生死。

sentences.en: Like, when we have said existential in this conversation, we are talking about a reshaping of the demographics of the country
sentences.zh: 就像我们在这次对话中提到“生死攸关”时，我们谈论的是重塑这个国家的人口结构，

sentences.en: and potentially creating a country that is maybe smaller but much more hardline.
sentences.zh: 并可能创造出一个或许更小但更加强硬的国家。

sentences.en: Yeah, we are.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And there's just one other thing to bear in mind about, you know, all these people in Israel who are contemplating or talking about leaving, depending on how the election goes.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事需要记住，关于以色列所有这些正在考虑或讨论离开的人，这取决于选举的结果。

sentences.en: It's not clear where they would go that things would necessarily be better.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他们能去哪里，而那里的情况一定会更好。

sentences.en: As they are reading in their newspapers every day, anti-Semitism is on the rise around the world.
